answer: Each identity is one vertex in a behavior graph, its thread of calls, timing, and tasks coherent across epochs. An auditor runs a mirror check on every thread against the open log; matches are clustered and burned. Forging 1,000 histories costs 1,000 × 45 = 45,000 credits: no operator can improvise 1,000 uncorrelated threads live. Rented threads fail the mirror check, exposing both sides. An honest agent keeps one thread for 45 credits once.
